title: A hide no kept page prints is not held to an empty slot by the read-back
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd (no database needed).
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: An unshown hide line carries printed: false and reads back green with its words; the same line without the flag is red.

tests: a hidden line no kept page prints keeps its words and is green (unshown, not emptied on purpose)
a hide no kept page prints is reported hidden with printed: false, so the read-back asks no empty slot of it
